title: STD-9: adopt Reusable GitHub Actions workflows shared by every tenant
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** OPEN-STANDARDS-1 audit 2026-11-25: `reusable-workflows` is planned in seed/standards/standards.json
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation standards --check && python3 -c "import json,sys;e=[x for x in json.load(open('seed/standards/standards.json'))['entries'] if x['id']=='reusable-workflows'][0];sys.exit(e['support'] not in ('supported','partial'))"
**Status:** open

Reusable GitHub Actions workflows shared by every tenant. Tenants call the platform's checks, deploy and supply-chain workflows instead of carrying copies that drift.

Lands in `seed/.github/workflows/bootstrap.yml` (and its seed twin so every system inherits it). Move the register entry `reusable-workflows` to supported with `how` paths and a passing test in the same change; replace the home-grown format, do not add a second one.

**Prediction:** standards_supported >= 45 within 336 h
**Out of scope:** adopting a standard nothing in the system reads; a parallel format kept beside the old one.
